title: Software Engineer - Systems & Infrastructure Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Systems & Infrastructure.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: C/C++/Rust/Go fundamentals, memory management, pointer arithmetic, threads/locks, and basic socket programming.
2. Mid-level: Concurrency models (epoll/kqueue, event loops, thread pools), storage engine internals (LSM trees, B-trees, WAL), network protocols (TCP, HTTP/2, gRPC), and Linux system calls.
3. Senior: Distributed consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos), lock-free data structures, memory-mapped I/O, kernel bypass (eBPF, DPDK), cache coherence, and hardware-software performance tuning.
4. Staff-plus: Planetary distributed storage/compute architecture, custom hardware acceleration integration, and fleet-wide reliability.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Target low-level systems projects, kernel interactions, and distributed infrastructure described in candidate's brief.
- Probe performance bottlenecks at the hardware, OS, and network layers.
